subject: general
question:
Vishakha joined five different hobby classes viz. Painting, Dancing, Modelling, Singing and Cooking. She attends each class on different days of the same week from Monday to Friday but not necessarily in the same order. She attends Modelling class on Wednesday. She attends neither Painting nor Dancing class on Thursday and Friday. She attends Cooking class on Friday.

On which day does she attend Singing class?
solution:
Vishakha joined five different hobby classes viz. Painting, Dancing, Modelling, Singing and Cooking.

She attends each class on different days of the same week from Monday to Friday but not necessarily in the same order.

1. She attends Modelling class on Wednesday.

2. She attends neither Painting nor Dancing class on Thursday and Friday.

3. She attends Cooking class on Friday.
